checks.name: Inputs
checks.output: R0-03 evidence SHA-256 is 9d28baa7ae4978f0577693fb1a48957cc238b625cee5e82fc745cb8d53f1e191. The decision cites its immutable base, Linux 6.8.0-124-generic, Python 3.12.3, direct-foreground mode, null service manager and five-second wait bound.

checks.name: Baseline
checks.output: The verifier requires direct-process as the sole core baseline, prohibits self-daemonization and requires explicit argv spawn, typed readiness, epoch fencing, bounded drain, typed/signal shutdown and isolated descendant cleanup contracts.

checks.name: Adapters
checks.output: The matrix separates direct-process, systemd, launchd and container capabilities. All three supervisor adapters are optional-unproven; every unmeasured capability has a reason. Direct resource accounting is also unmeasured rather than inferred from process cleanup.

checks.name: Failure behavior
checks.output: Pre-ready and post-ready outcomes are bound to measured R0-03 behavior. Drain-timeout and restart ownership are defined but explicitly unmeasured. Every outcome forbids two active owners.

checks.name: Portability
checks.output: The decision forbids core dependence on adapter features and requires unsupported adapters to use the direct foreground baseline while preserving the portable ownership protocol.

checks.name: Revisit rule
checks.output: Recommendation requires two measured environments, 30 consecutive passes per environment, 10 injections per failure mode, zero ownership violations, zero orphaned processes, a passing direct fallback and a measured operational benefit.

extra_checks.name: Decision regression suite
extra_checks.output: 14 tests passed, including five runtime-topology decision and negative-mutation tests plus the existing nine implementation-DAG tests.

unresolved_risks: controller loss during a fenced handoff
notes: No supervisor adapter, service file, process, socket, dependency, credential, network request, privilege or host configuration was created. Unmeasured capabilities and risks remain null-equivalent decision inputs with explicit reasons; no performance or availability claim was inferred.
